summary: Checked all 26 existing estimates against the complete 375-line markdown conversion and the cited PDF pages, including direct text extraction of PDF pp. 4-9 and 16-20 and visual inspection of Figures 1-4 in memory. The six numerical AI-follow contrasts reproduce the printed means, SEs, p-values, and signed Cohen's d values correctly. No numerical transcription error or incorrect requested code was found in the existing estimates. Model-specific and figure-specific analyzed counts are not printed; the null counts are not replaced with the pre-exclusion pool or values derived from exclusions or degrees of freedom. Completeness fails for 28 explicitly plotted final-draft measurement/arm combinations: ten AI-first versus Human-only outcomes, ten AI-parallel versus Human-only outcomes, and eight AI-follow versus Human-only subdomain outcomes with separately identified human and AI evaluators. These require figure-only records with null numerical statistics. The ten AI-first records answer after_ai; the others answer with_ai. Excluding post-treatment-adjusted ANCOVA effects does not exclude the corresponding final-draft graphical outcomes. The four numerical subdomain results with unspecified evaluator must not be copied into both labeled rating versions. No additional numerical AI-versus-AI contrast is reported. Self-reports, balance checks, and scorer-reliability statistics are properly excluded. The linked researchtools.pdf supplement and the Research Square article-page fallback were both requested with urllib and User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1; both failed with WinError 10013. No supplemental contents or unprinted values are assumed.
